ocr_pages.text: Cystoprostatectomy: high-grade papillary transitional cell carcinoma invading perivesical soft tissue. No regional lymph nodes submitted. All resection margins free of carcinoma. Lymphovascular invasion is present. Separate prostate adenocarcinoma: Gleason 3+4, pT2.
